name: Nikkō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nikkō city emblem in orange and red: a stylised flower of six orange petals around a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Nikkō, a city in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Nikkō city emblem — a stylised flower of six orange petals around a red disc
